name: EPIC 212783112
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 8.1 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212783112 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.118304 (16th-84th percentiles 7.809344-8.44623), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212783112 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4258.632812 (16th-84th percentiles 4130.546875-4391.523438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,259 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.98 solar masses and 8.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,940 K at its surface.
